title: Korea's privacy commission says 1,019 breach reports in January-October, announces emergency inspections from December
date_note: Financial News (27 Nov) reports the commission's announcement; the page gives no earlier day.
summary: Financial News reports that South Korea's Personal Information Protection Commission received 1,019 personal-data breach reports in January to October, which it says is about 2.3 times last year's full-year total of 447. By sector, 271 were public and 748 private. The commission says it will step up threat-information sharing with agencies including the science ministry, the Financial Services Commission and the National Intelligence Service, and run intensive management for three months from December.
plain: Korea's privacy regulator says breach reports this year are already about 2.3 times last year's total, and it plans three months of intensive management from December.
exec: Korea's privacy regulator reports 1,019 breach reports in January to October and plans three months of intensive management from December.

validation.note: Only Financial News read; the commission's own release was not read.

evidence.quote: 올해 1~10월 개인정보 유출 신고 건수는 1019건으로 지난해 연간 신고 건수(447건)의 약 2.3배에 달한다.
